references.text: The same ritual with the oil remaining on the priest's hand, which is placed on the head of the one to be cleansed, to make atonement for him
The anointing oil is poured on Aaron's head as part of the consecration ritual, similar use of oil on the head
The preceding part of the ritual where the priest takes oil in his left hand and uses it for cleansing
The priest makes atonement (וְכִפֶּר) for the person before the Lord, using the same terminology for atonement
The priest makes atonement for sins, using כִּפֶּר (atonement) in the same way before the Lord
The anointing oil is poured on the head as part of the priestly consecration
Oil that flows down over the head, upon Aaron, as a symbol of blessing and sanctification
